method: Three fresh NEAR-only wallets per arm; fixed browser assets and harness; only A and B deployments vary.
limitations: Provider CPU and wall times describe whole invocations, not individual cryptographic operations.
Application clocks freeze during CPU work; application spans are not transport timers.
Small sequential samples do not establish a latency percentile or placement success rate.
D1 counts cover bound-root loads only; total Gateway D1 and backend Console calls are unavailable.
No diagnostic location fetches were added. Physical colocation is not proved.
Hosted per-operation CPU profiles and internal payload-byte counts are unavailable. A separate local sample is recorded below.

localCpuProfile.method: CDP Profiler, 100 microsecond requested sampling interval, local workerd, same release WASM hashes as hosted candidate. One successful fresh wallet after one interrupted wallet warmed the processes.
limitations: One diagnostic sample, with profiler overhead; not a controlled performance comparison.
Sample weights are elapsed microseconds between samples, not provider CPU billing.
Inlining and async boundaries prevent complete attribution to receipt verification, encryption, serialization, and protocol.
Visible stack categories overlap; do not add their totals.
Local hardware and local database behavior differ from hosted Workers.
